entities.summary: Zaid bin Hussein (Arabic: زيد بن الحسين; was an Iraqi prince who was a member of the Hashemite dynasty and the head of the Royal House of Iraq from 1958 until his death, after the royal line founded by his brother Faisal I of Iraq was killed.
